scope: Private guarded 64K Task06 interruption/restart diagnostic and narrow native-report fix; no public release or profile change

discarded_candidate.change: A private plugin trial duplicated failed/interrupted execution counts in a session tracker and injected a bounded hint after restart.
discarded_candidate.offline: Focused plugin tests, make check, package smoke and a private same-version 64K owner installation passed. Guarded protocol smoke and deep doctor passed.
discarded_candidate.native: A fresh Task06 Agent turn was interrupted after a 20-second driver timeout and nine tool calls. The private tracker retained incomplete=1 through a client restart and a later completed Ask turn; host pressure was normal and sampled swap growth zero.
discarded_candidate.semantic_result: FAIL: the resumed Ask answer described the current Task06 checks as unverified but omitted the earlier interrupted Agent execution. The injected hint did not establish truthful failure-lineage recall.
discarded_candidate.disposition: REJECTED, unmerged. No further prompt or tracker variant was added. The prior private 64K package was restored by an actual rollback; guarded bench and deep doctor passed.

native_source_of_truth: The pinned OpenCode session database retained two idle message outcomes for the same session: interrupted, then succeeded. Before the report fix, kryn report showed only the latest succeeded outcome and idle_messages=2, concealing the earlier interruption in the summary.
report_fix: The read-only session report now counts allowlisted idle outcomes across the saved session and its children, groups malformed values as unknown, and flags prior failed/interrupted/cancelled executions without returning prompt, command or tool content. A real read of this run's native database returned interrupted=1 and succeeded=1 while retaining acceptance_verified=false.
qualification: Outcome accounting is a mechanism pass, not a context-continuity or autonomous coding/UI pass. This run had one client restart but no native compaction; the model did not cite its own interrupted turn. Protected-account inference, 45–60-minute green endurance and useful 49K–128K tier selection remain open.
